biggest_catch: The rewards are gift cards, not cash — and you have to enroll your thermostat or buy an eligible product first. Xcel's AC Rewards pages state the rewards as bill credits on the enrollment page, but check the current terms for exactly how your reward is paid.
catches: Must be an Xcel Energy South Dakota residential customer with central air conditioning and a qualifying smart thermostat.
You agree to let Xcel make small adjustments during peak events.
Reward delivery method (bill credit vs. gift card) should be confirmed on the current enrollment page before relying on it.
Annual rewards assume you stay enrolled year to year.
